say:1:1030112601:1.text: Evergreen Conservatory... Hmm... I wonder how many times I've done the introduction.
say:1:1030112601:1.source_cn: 冬青学会……嗯，我在想这是第几次介绍学会了。

say:2:1030112602:1.text: The Evergreen Conservatory is an institution that has gathered scholars from various academic fields to study the wonders of Esperia. Research includes a wide range of disciplines including astronomy, geography, history, and ecology.
say:2:1030112602:1.source_cn: 冬青学会汇聚了各学术界人才的组织，研究范围非常广，从天...

say:3:1030112603:1.text: Our goal is to dispel people's fear of the unknown by empowering them with knowledge.
say:3:1030112603:1.source_cn: 让人们掌握更多的知识，以此来驱散对未知的恐惧。

say:4:1030112604:1.text: And to prevent humans from heading toward self-destruction again by discerning universal laws from knowledge and learning the lessons from the past...
say:4:1030112604:1.source_cn: 或是在知识中提炼出万事万物的规律，总结历史教训，避免人...

say:5:1030112605:1.text: Are you now wondering why I'm sitting here doing nothing? Well, having enough rest helps one focus on their research!
say:5:1030112605:1.source_cn: 你问我为什么能悠闲地坐在这里？唔……休息也是为了更好的...
